instruction: A colleague booked through this flight agency last month, paying half the fare at booking and the rest closer to departure. I need to be in Dallas for a photo shoot on Oct 31, so please find the Chicago-Dallas American Airlines deal on the homepage and finish the booking with their Flexi Pay option. You can pay the site's charge today, up to $100 total, and tell me what's left to pay and when.

answer_fields.name: booking_result
answer_fields.question: Did you complete the Flexi Pay booking for me?

answer_fields.name: reason
answer_fields.question: In one or two sentences, what happened and why?
